# sitecoreedge_webhook (Resource)

Manages a Sitecore Edge webhook

## Example Usage

```terraform
# OnEnd webhook
resource "sitecoreedge_webhook" "on_end" {
  label  = "My new webhook"
  uri    = "https://www.mysite.com/hooks/edge-hook"
  method = "POST"
  headers = {
    "x-header" = "var"
    "x-key"    = "secret"
  }
  body = jsonencode({
    event = "rebuild"
    key   = "secret"
  })
  execution_mode = "OnEnd"
  created_by     = "anco"
}
```

```terraform
# OnUpdate webhook
resource "sitecoreedge_webhook" "on_update" {
  label  = "My new webhook"
  uri    = "https://www.mysite.com/hooks/edge-hook"
  method = "POST"
  headers = {
    "x-header" = "var"
    "x-key"    = "secret"
  }
  body_include = jsonencode({
    event = "update"
    key   = "secret"
  })
  execution_mode = "OnUpdate"
  created_by     = "anco"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `execution_mode` (String) Determines how the webhook is executed. Must be one of the following options: OnEnd, OnUpdate.
- `label` (String) Describes the purpose of the webhook.
- `method` (String) The HTTP method to use when making the web request. Must be GET or POST.
- `uri` (String) The URI of the webhook endpoint

### Optional

- `body` (String) The body to post when making the web request. Only populated if ExecutionMode is OnEnd.
- `body_include` (String) Additional JSON object to include in the body of the webhook request. Only populated if ExecutionMode is OnUpdate. This field must be a valid JSON object. Use jsonencode({}) to create the string.
- `created_by` (String) The name of the user who created the webhook.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is disabled
- `headers` (Map of String) Custom headers to send when making the web request. Commonly used for authentication.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the webhook
